title: Checkout errors after connection pool rollout
description: Checkout requests failed during the evening release.
impact: Checkout 5xx responses increased for 31 minutes; payment capture was not affected.

records.text: Deployment checkout-api v4.8.2 set database pool max connections from 80 to 12 per pod.
checkout-api: timeout waiting for DB connection after 2000ms (pool exhausted).
checkout-api: retry budget exhausted while acquiring DB connection.
db_pool_wait_p95_ms rose from 24 to 2000; active connections at 12/12 per pod.
Rollback restored pool max connections to 80; 5xx rate returned below 0.3% by 18:35 UTC.

title: Ingest lag during broker partition imbalance
description: Events accumulated in the ingestion queue during morning traffic.
impact: Event ingestion delayed up to 14 minutes; no confirmed event loss.

records.text: Partition reassignment concentrated 8 of 12 event partitions on broker-03.
broker-03: produce request queue saturated, throttling incoming messages.
broker-03 CPU reached 97%; brokers 01/02 below 40%; consumer lag peaked at 14 minutes.
Partitions redistributed evenly across three brokers; consumer lag recovered by 09:02 UTC.
